code:
i = 0
j = 0

while i < 10:
    print("Team {}".format(i))

    while j < 10:
        print("Team {}, turn #{}".format(i, j))

        j += 1

    i += 1
description: You identify which counter each loop reads and updates in the supplied program.

steps.description: You initialize i and j before entering the outer loop. The first message formats the current i as a team label.
You enter a second while loop that tests j. Its message includes both counters, and its update changes j.

steps.answer: The outer body's final update changes i. The j update is inside the inner body.
steps.question: Which counter changes at the end of the outer body?

steps.description: You reach the outer update after the inner loop finishes. The recorded output contains team labels and turn labels, showing the two message forms.
